verdict.rationale: Sentry's docs describe the Issues product (filtering by browser/device/error type), stack traces with suspect commits and PR comments, and release/source-map tracking, which together constitute the core error-grouping and release-tracking workflow. Community testimonials also affirm real-world use of Sentry's core monitoring stack in production. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the issue-grouping algorithm and a named 'regression detection' feature, plus independent hands-on confirmation of accuracy.
